Fighting Poverty in New York City

Robin Hood is New York City’s largest poverty-fighting organization. We fuel the most impactful organizations across the city to elevate people from poverty. In 2025, we invested $140 million in 515 grants to 295 organizations, and 2.7 million New Yorkers were served by Robin Hood-funded programs.
